title: Downhill Rivers
description: This project adds downhill river streams to the terrain generation using lithostitched to place into any world
body:
This mod adds rivers that generate across the overworld using lithostitched.\
\
All screenshots in the gallery use the following mods:\
DistantHorizons-3.0.3-b-1.21.1-fabric-neoforge\
lithostitched-1.7.9-neoforge-21.1\
middgard-1.2.1-1.21.1\
Oh-The-Trees-Youll-Grow-neoforge-1.21.1-5.3.2\
tectonic-3.0.22-neoforge-21.1\
\
The only dependency is lithostitched 1.7.9 neoforge 1.21.1, although I think the best results are seen with the mods previously mentioned.\
\
Now features a config for tweaking river curviness/amplitude, width, riverbank width, riverbank block palette, and biomes they spawn in.
